name: SPICE essentials
notes: Curated onetransistor drawings with existing aryajur SPICE templates and definition symbols. Generic device models and the 741-style behavioral model are original teaching approximations, not manufacturer-validated models. See docs/spice-library.md for defaults, terminal mapping, and limitations.

entries.name: Potentiometer
entries.notes: The source wiper repeated terminal 1; renumbered to 3. Two resistors model the wiper, with a 1 micro-ohm lower bound.

entries.name: Trimmer resistor
entries.notes: The source wiper repeated terminal 1; renumbered to 3. Two resistors model the wiper, with a 1 micro-ohm lower bound.

entries.name: Electrolytic capacitor
entries.notes: Polarized drawing; linear capacitor model does not simulate reverse-voltage damage. Both plates have equal dimensions and are centered about the midpoint of the fixed, on-grid pins. Pin leads meet the outer plate edges.

entries.name: Inductor with core
entries.notes: Core artwork retained; default inductance is linear and does not model saturation.

entries.name: NPN transistor

entries.name: PNP transistor
entries.notes: Generic teaching model; terminals are 3=collector, 1=base, 2=emitter. Pin names added without moving geometry.

entries.name: 741 op-amp
entries.notes: Corrected repeated source pin numbers to the 741 signal/supply pinout. Original educational behavioral model: 200k DC gain, 1 MHz approximate GBW, 0.5 V/us nominal slew limit, 2 Mohm differential input, 75 ohm output, and rail headroom. Not the manufacturer transistor-level model; no bias/noise/thermal/current-limit/common-mode effects or offset pins.

entries.name: Transformer
entries.notes: Derived four-terminal two-winding transformer. Removed the source secondary centre-tap pin and assigned distinct secondary terminals 3/4. Linear coupled inductors; turns ratio is sqrt(Lprimary/Lsecondary), top terminals have the same polarity. Four-terminal 1:1 drawing uses mirrored windings of equal height, paired on-grid terminals and polarity dots, and a centered core. Removed the obsolete second-secondary polarity dot and zero-size ellipse.

entries.name: XTAL (quartz crystal)
entries.notes: Quartz variant derived from onetransistor two-terminal ceramic resonator artwork. Generic motional series RLC with a shunt capacitor; nominal series resonance is set by Frequency in Hz. No manufacturer-specific temperature, drive-level, or nonlinear behavior.

entries.name: Ceramic resonator
entries.notes: Source two-terminal ceramic resonator artwork retained. Generic motional series RLC with a shunt capacitor; nominal series resonance is set by Frequency in Hz. No manufacturer-specific temperature, drive-level, or nonlinear behavior.
